summary: @nebula.js/cli-serve 7.1.2 ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`, which runs on `npm install`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` identifiers and array-rotation string decoding) and downloads a Bun runtime archive from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-only bytecode-cjs blob (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with array-rotation obfuscation; it is not listed in the `files` allow-list in package.json (which declares only `assets`, `BREAKING.md`, `command.js`, `data`, `dist`, `lib`), so it is undeclared tarball content whose only purpose is to be executed by the freshly-downloaded Bun runtime. Upstream nebula.js (qlik-oss/nebula.js, authored by QlikTech International AB) does not ship a preinstall hook, setup.mjs, or a Bun payload — 7.1.2 is a trojanized or impersonating publish. Installing this version causes automatic execution of an opaque obfuscated payload under an alternate runtime chosen to evade Node-based scanners.
